mapper.select: SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, CONTENT_TYPE_ID AS contentTypeId, CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, TITLE, FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, ADDR1, ADDR2, MAP_X AS mapX, MAP_Y AS mapY, TEL, HOMEPAGE, OVERVIEW FROM TOUR_PLACE WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, IMG_NAME AS imgName, ORIGIN_IMG_URL AS originImgUrl, SERIAL_NUM AS serialNum, SMALL_IMAGE_URL AS smallImageUrl FROM PLACE_IMG WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} ORDER BY SERIAL_NUM
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAVORITE WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, INFO_CENTER AS infoCenter, OPEN_DATE AS openDate, PARKING, REST_DATE AS restDate, USE_SEASON AS useSeason, USE_TIME AS useTime FROM PLACE_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, INFO_CENTER_CULTURE AS infoCenterCulture, PARKING_CULTURE AS parkingCulture, PARKING_FEE AS parkingFee, REST_DATE_CULTURE AS restDateCulture, USE_FEE AS useFee, USE_TIME_CULTUE AS useTimeCulture, SPEND_TIME AS spendTime FROM CULTURE_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, AGE_LIMIT AS ageLimit, BOOKING_PLACE AS bookingPlace, DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS eventStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(EVENT_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS eventEndDate, PLAY_TIME AS playTime, EVENT_HOMEPAGE AS eventHomepage, SPEND_TIME_FESTIVAL AS spendTimeFestival, SPONSOR1, SPONSOR1_TEL AS sponsor1Tel, SPONSOR2, SPONSOR2_TEL AS sponsor2Tel, USE_TIME_FESTIVAL AS useTimeFestival FROM FESTIVAL_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, EXP_AGE_RANGE_LEPORTS AS expAgeRangeLeports, INFO_CENTER_LEPOSRTS AS infoCenterLeports, OPEN_PERIOD AS openPeriod, PARKING_LEPORTS AS parkingLeports, PARKING_FEE_LEPORTS AS parkingFeeLeports, RESERVATION FROM LEPORTS_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, ACCOM_COUNT_LODGING AS accomCountLodging, CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime, CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime, CHK_COOKING AS chkCooking, FOOD_PLACE AS foodPlace, INFO_CENTER_LODGING AS infoCenterLodging, PARKING_LODGING AS parkingLodging, PICKUP, ROOM_COUNT AS roomCount, RESERVATION_LODGING AS reservationLodging, RESERVATION_URL AS reservationUrl, ROOM_TYPE AS roomType, SCALE_LODGING AS scaleLodging, SUB_FACILITY AS subFacility, BARBECUE, BEAUTY, BEVERAGE, BICYCLE, CAMPFIRE, FITNESS, KARAOKE, PUBLIC_BATH AS publicBath, PUBLIC_PC AS publicPc, SAUNA, SEMINAR, SPORTS, REFUND_REGULATION AS refundRegulation FROM LODGING_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, CULTURE_CENTER AS cultureCenter, FAIR_DAY AS fairDay, INFO_CENTER_SHOPPING AS infoCenterShopping, OPEN_DATE_SHOPPING AS openDateShopping, OPEN_TIME AS openTime, PARKING_SHOPPING AS parkingShopping, REST_DATE_SHOPPING AS restDateShopping, RESTROOM, SHOP_GUIDE AS shopGuide FROM SHOP_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, FIRST_MENU AS firstMenu, INFO_CENTER_FOOD AS infoCenterFood, KIDS_FACILITY AS kidsFacility, OPEN_TIME_FOOD AS openTimeFood, PACKING, PARKING_FOOD AS parkingFood, RESERVATION_FOOD AS reservationFood, REST_DATE_FOOD AS restDateFood FROM FOOD_INTRO WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT CONTENT_ID AS contentId, TITLE, FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, ADDR1, CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId FROM TOUR_PLACE WHERE CONTENT_ID != #{excludeId} AND ( 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{mapY})) * COS(RADIANS(MAP_Y)) * COS(RADIANS(MAP_X) - RADIANS(#{mapX})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{mapY})) * SIN(RADIANS(MAP_Y)) ) ) <= 5 ORDER BY ( 6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{mapY})) * COS(RADIANS(MAP_Y)) * COS(RADIANS(MAP_X) - RADIANS(#{mapX})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{mapY})) * SIN(RADIANS(MAP_Y)) ) ) LIMIT 6

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.USER_ID AS userId, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE AS profileImg, R.CONTENT, R.REVIEW_IMAGE AS reviewImage, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM REVIEW R JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_ID = U.NO WHERE R.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND R.REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW (USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT, REVIEW_IMAGE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, NOW())
INSERT INTO FAVORITE (USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FAVORITE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT (USER_ID, REVIEW_ID, REPORT_TYPE, REASON, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reviewId}, #{reportType}, #{reason}, NOW())
